cohort: The study included four multigravida women with placenta accreta and gestational age 37-39 weeks, who underwent cesarean section and hysterectomy with Intraoperative Aortic Balloon Occlusion.
finding: Intra-Aortic Ballooning Occlusion was found to be an effective method to reduce bleeding complications during and after cesarean section in pregnancies with placenta accreta.
mod_finding: Intra-Aortic Ballooning Occlusion during cesarean section was an effective method to reduce bleeding complications in pregnancies with placenta accreta.
